name: Setlist
summary:
A music party game for three to thirty, played together in a web browser. Each round a theme is drawn, such as a song that reminds you of summer or a hit from 1998, and every player secretly picks a track that fits it. The picks then play one at a time as 30-second previews while the table races to name the title and the artist; the sooner a guess lands, the more it is worth, and the player who chose the song can spend hints to help.

After each round everyone votes for the pick that fit the theme best, so good curation scores alongside good guessing. Besides the classic table, the game offers teams of two, a casual mode, an elimination ladder, a Chaos mode with items that disrupt the round, and a solo marathon.
